title: Japanese LLC DAO where 1 million people can join and contribute using Cardano's Dapps (From Japan to the World DAO)

ms.promise:
In Japan, legal revisions have been made to allow for the establishment of DAOs and the operation of businesses by utilizing an LLC. However, the establishment of a DAO involves issues related to Japan's Financial Instruments and Exchange Act and Companies Act. Additionally, if tokens are to be issued, the Payment Services Act will also be a concern. Violations can result in severe penalties. Furthermore, when operating a DAO, if the appropriate articles of incorporation and regulations are not created, it could be legally invalid.
Therefore, it is essential to have a lawyer scrutinize the legal compliance based on the purpose of the DAO, the content of the tokens to be issued, and the method of organizational management. First, we will determine the purpose of the DAO, the content of the tokens to be issued, and the method of organizational management in consultation with DAO experts. Based on the purpose of the DAO, the content of the tokens to be issued, and the method of organizational management, we will ensure legal compliance, create the necessary articles of incorporation and regulations, and establish an LLC-based DAO (Million Member DAO LLC, "MMD") as a corporation in Jap

ms.report:
1. Milestone Output (1/1) — Completed
As the second pilot project selected through community voting (for the utilization of vacant and traditional houses through the DAO), MMD members carried out renovation work on vacant and traditional houses across Japan. In summary, we have:
・Mobilized MMD members to participate in actual renovation work at five partner sites together with the entities engaged in those renovations;
・Airdropped tokens to participating members (off-chain, recorded in the treasury ledger);
・Prepared the token design and completed a legal check;
・Conducted promotion of the project; and
・Managed members through participation in Discord and the NFTs they were granted.

MMD tokens are usable to obtain the right to stay in renovated vacant/traditional houses, and can be exchanged through a lottery for the right to receive services provided by various companies. The specific token design has been tentatively decided for this project.
Supporting evidence: Results Report, Token Grant Record , Token Design Document PDF.
2. Acceptance Criteria (1/1) — Met
Criterion A — Number of Collaborations with renovation entities (5 or more): MET.
We established partnerships with the following five entities/projects engaged in the renovation of vacant or traditional houses:
・Kanaya (香奈屋) — guesthouse from a vacant house, Manno Town, Kagawa Prefecture
・Rasen (らせん) — four-story vacant house, temple-town district, Kotohira, Kagawa Prefecture
・Hotel QOL — barrier-free hotel / vacant-property development, Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture
・Ise Vegas (Ise Creators Garage / 伊勢ベガス) — renovated family property as an exchange hub, Ise City, Mie Prefecture
・GRASS ROOTS — satoyama / abandoned-property regeneration, Ina City, Nagano Prefecture

Each partnership was confirmed through (i) participation in our Discord and (ii) issuance of a partnership NFT. This satisfies the requirement of 5 or more collaborations (5/5).
